shared_elements: repeated small linear marks or patterning
justification: The most specific correspondence is that both are upright carved stone surfaces with horizontal divisions and profile animal/bird imagery rendered in relief or incision. The biggest difference is that A has a highly organized scene with a large standing winged figure beside a dense floral/tree motif and a text-like upper band, whereas B is a rougher, more schematic multi-register surface of separated animal signs with no comparable central figure-and-tree composition.
